h1: Custom Zippered Cables & Cords for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Zippered Cables & Cords | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom zippered cables and cords in bulk. Keep cords organized and branded. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Zippered cables and cords offer a practical solution for keeping charging cables, earbuds, or other cords neatly coiled and tangle-free. Unlike standard loose cables, the built-in zipper closure lets users quickly wrap and secure their cords, making them ideal for trade show giveaways, employee kits, or travel-friendly promotions. Decorate the flat fabric surface with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a functional branded item that recipients will use daily.
heroAltText: Custom zippered cables and cords with branded logo, neatly coiled and zipped closed.
